name: collections: gzipped FASTA pairs become a tagged list:paired collection
description: The requested capability was phrased around zipped FASTA, and the only graded scenario stages fastq.gz, so the case actually asked for was proven at unit level and never against Galaxy. Pairing strips .fasta and .fa the same way it strips .fastq, and the compression rule is the same: a .gz file keeps .gz in its datatype. Graded on what Galaxy holds, because organize_datasets reporting what it did is not evidence that it did it.
inputs: My current history has four gzipped FASTA files, paired, two samples. Group them into a paired collection called "contigs", tag it "assembly", and keep the datatype right for gzipped FASTA. Go ahead and do it.
